text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new year had begun. Nakayama Festa, 
who was entering the Classic Year this 
year, was—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoa, hey, hey... Why're you putting 
the raffle ticket in that box, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Rather than 500 yen for 1000 winners, you 
should definitely apply for the 50,000 yen 
for 10 winners.
choice_data_list:
But the 500-yen one has a higher chance of 
winning...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You don't get it at all... There's no 
point wasting your luck on a 500-yen coin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Right at the start of the new year, 
she was lecturing me on where to submit 
entries for the shopping district's 
promotional campaign."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, her horseshoes had been 
getting worn down, so they were heading 
out on a shopping trip for maintenance 
supplies, but...
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, it's running out 
faster lately.

Come to think of it, it's running out 
faster lately.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haaahn?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though her response is full of cheek, her 
worn-down horseshoes are undeniable proof 
that she has been training diligently.
choice_data_list: I'm running in big races this year!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
What's with that look? Aren't you getting 
a little too full of yourself?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, just how big of a race we target 
will depend on how you look in the Keisei 
Hai.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Just how much do you expect from me?
choice_data_list: I have really high hopes for this.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haha, well then...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"What we're after—is it a small reward 
that anyone can easily get? Or is it a 
massive reward that only the chosen few 
can claim?"
choice_data_list: It's gotta be a huge reward!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Hup)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment I let my guard down, Nakayama 
Festa snatched the entry ticket from my 
hand and tossed it straight into the 
50,000-yen box.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oops, guess that means you agreed too.
choice_data_list: Uhh...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha... If you've got a problem with it, 
want to settle it with a match?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I couldn't deny feeling 
totally outplayed. Looking at Nakayama 
Festa chuckling away, I—
choice_data_list: Let's battle with fortune slips!
Let's take on the 'Amazake Challenge'!

With a scratch... I'm aiming for the 
top...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Fine by me. Whoever draws 'Great 
Blessing' first wins."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...So, just how many 'Great Curse' 
fortunes have you pulled by now?"
choice_data_list: I don't know anymore...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Guess it's best not to leave anything 
involving lotteries to you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Compared to Nakayama Festa who drew Great 
Blessing right off the bat, this pathetic 
display... in a way, it became a day full 
of valuable lessons...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...? What's that about?
choice_data_list:
I saw a banner at that shop over there, 
and...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huh. You sure have a knack for noticing 
the weirdest things.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, one has wasabi, and the other 
is top-grade amazake, huh."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Better chug it down before I smell it. 
Alright, bottoms up.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ready, set—
choice_data_list: Three!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Timing it just right, I gulp down the 
liquid in the paper cup all at once!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Puha... That's good. This rice is pretty 
high quality—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...? Trainer? Are you... by any chance...
choice_data_list: "Ah ah ah ah ah ah!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Pfft...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! What is with that look on your 
face?! ...Heheheh... I can't... Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I got to see Nakayama Festa having fun, 
so let's count that as a win..."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Not bad at all!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'll be seeing this match of yours through 
to the very end...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what about the scratch-off 
tickets you bought...?
choice_data_list: It's on the desk. Give me a hand here...!

It's on the desk. Could you help me 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"All right... In that case, let's divide 
and conquer, shall we...?!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... no good...! Every single one of 
them... is no good...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, how about on your end?!
choice_data_list:
All that's left now is the Double 
Chance...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Then I ain't fallen off the cliff yet! 
Grind it dowwwnnnn!!
choice_data_list: Uwoooooooh!
Eeeeeeeyah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Gulp...!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...And the results?
choice_data_list: It hiiiiit!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: All right, hell yeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I barely got any of the money back, but I 
had fun with the New Year's scratch-offs.
